suggested_change: Separate concerns: (1) Score changes must be justified by call evidence OR carry-forward language (mutually exclusive rules per condition), not both. (2) When call data is corrupted/incomplete, allow explicit 'no change' rather than forcing carry-forward language. (3) Next-step concreteness should be evaluated independently of score regression logic. Current rubric conflates state consistency, evidence standards, and question quality into overlapping criteria.
